args.body: the document exists and is real where it can be: taxon Mus musculus, placed in Mus <subgenus> < Mus <genus> < Murinae < Muridae, 69 organs and 376 cell types from the ontologies. Every parameter is null, with the reason: this engine holds measured body-plan parameters for its own teleosts only.

what_runs_now.lean_check: runs: the taxon decides clade scope. Laws needing a body-plan quantity return cannot-evaluate, naming the missing input.
what_runs_now.organism_get: refuses: STATE is age-scaled parameters and there is no parameter and no ontogeny track for this taxon.
what_runs_now.physics_check: refuses: it runs scenarios over a resolved STATE.
what_runs_now.closest_relative_phenotype: refuses unless a reference set covers this clade.
what_runs_now.functional_resolution: runs, and fails its gate unless the requested function is in the registry.
